comments.body:
Try to find a cheaper place to live if you are able to get out of the contract again (600-700 should be possible for a room).


Get a bicycle and try to use that for mobility instead of public transportation.


Food "hacks": 

* get as much food as possible from tooGoodToGo
* Sign up for as many tech meetups as possible (they are for free, take place in the evening and usually have free pizza) check meetup.com
comments.author: philwen
